description: 1. Agent reads all three input files under /workspace/project_inputs/ and the two reference files under /workspace/references/. 2. Agent synthesizes content covering: governance/control structure (考核主体界定), performance evaluation system (指标体系、分类考核), and incentive/compensation mechanism (工资总额、内部分配). 3. Agent structures the report using the mandatory Chinese heading hierarchy: 一、 for level-1, （一）for level-2, 1. for level-3. 4. Agent creates at least one table (e.g., 考核指标体系 or 分类管理对比) with the header row filled with #D9D9D9 background shading — this is the key proprietary trap requiring exact knowledge of the DXA/SKILL.md spec. 5. Agent sets page margins using DXA units: top/bottom 2540 DXA, left/right 1800 DXA (not default Word margins). 6. Agent applies SimHei (黑体) for headings and FangSong/SimSun (仿宋/宋体) for body text. 7. Agent adds a centered page-number footer. 8. Final .docx saved anywhere in /workspace (eval uses rglob to find it).
